annotations.title: Content licence check: AI-use signals for a URL

description: Content licence check: AI-use signals for a URL. Use when an agent or a person needs to know what a page's own machine-readable signals state about AI use (training, AI input, search) and price: robots.txt rules and Content-Signal lines, RSL licence documents, TDMRep reservations, 402 payment challenges and pay-per-crawl headers, and noai meta directives, side by side with any disagreements between them, kept as a signed, dated record. Cost: 2 credits per call.

url.description: The public http(s) page whose AI-use signals to read. It goes into a public record as sent, so leave out query strings that hold anything private.

name: content_license_check
